nom: Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Essence Water Hydrating Face Toner for Dry

avis.texte: Update: I reorder this whenever I am out - I love what it does to and for my skin. They also have a ginseng/snail mucin mix that works so well for my rosacea redness. If I use CosRX centella asiatica toner, then this ginseng essence, and top it off with either CoxRX snail mucin or the BOJ ginseng/smail mucin, my skin is not only glowing with a healthy glow, but the redness is very much calmed down! That's all I have on my face as I write this and my skin feels wonderful. I will add some retinoid and/or moisturizer later. Love it! -------------------- This is my first try of Beauty of Joseon and I would definitely try other products from this brand. My skin loves K-beauty, and as well I often find some K-beauty brands are not as pricey. This one is reasonably priced and a little goes a long way so that makes the value better as well. I love how you have to 'shake out' a bit of the essence so that it isn't wasted - not to much comes out at a time and you don't need much. A few shakes onto my palm and I pat and then press the essence onto my skin. Patting and pressing works better than trying to 'rub' it onto the skin. I do a multi-step routine - since I work remotely, I have the time to take my time. I cleanse and immediately use a toner--though this is both essence and toner, right now I have a separate milky toner. I sometimes apply this essence right after toning or I'll wait 10-15 minutes. avis.titre: It was great till it was not..
avis.texte: I really do not do reviews but in this case I feel like I have to, to warn people have sensitive skin to be careful if they want to try this skincare line. I ordered my first beauty of Joseon last year I got the ginseng toner, the cleanser and the serum that goes with it. Up on using the product I felt that my skin is healthy and glowing and clear then it have ever been. And to make it clear I have a hyper sensitive skin and on top of that I have eczema so my skin can flare up anytime if it wants to or if I use something that irritates it. Since I use the products for a year everything was doing fine everything was perfect I'm loving the product there's no problem with it my skin is loving it not until the beginning of this year all of a sudden my face broke out. My face started to itch I thought it was just itchy but when I look at it on the mirror I see some redness on my skin and some rash, so basically my face was flaring up but I did not blame it to the skincare that I was using because like I said a year prior everything was perfect so I thought it's just my skin doing its thing and it's going to go away. So I stopped using the skin care line until my face was fully healed so that was about June when my face finally healed from the flare-up that I had from the beginning of the this year. I didn't use the toner because I ran out, but I still have the oil based cleanser and I'm being using it on and off and my face is okay it didn't flare up it no allergic reaction or any

I have oily combo skin that's acne prone but I got this as preventative skincare since ginseng is known to be anti-aging and I'm in my 20s. Right of the bat, I love how the packaging feels, it's very nice quality since it's sleek and has a weight to it. The product itself has no fragrance at all which will work well for people who are sensitive to fragrances. The consistency is slightly thicker than water but it's still very runny! This absorbs so well into the skin and doesn't feel tacky at all, I find that this is very moisturizing on my skin. After the first few uses, I can definitely see an overall improvement in my skin health and it gave my skin a nice glow. After using it for a while, my skin barrier has been a lot better! I don't see any anti-aging benefits yet, but that's also because I don't have fine-lines yet. But overall, this product is great for the skin barrier and glow! Your face will feel very soft

avis.titre: Lightweight and Leaves a Nice Hydrated FinishLightweight and Leaves a Nice Hydrated Finish
avis.texte: I’ve been using this Beauty of Joseon Ginseng Essence Water and my first impression has been very positive. The texture is lightweight and slightly watery, so it spreads easily without feeling sticky or heavy. In my experience, a small amount goes a long way. It absorbed well into my skin and left it looking fresh with a healthy, hydrated glow. I also found that it layered nicely without feeling greasy. The bottle is easy to use, and I like that you can simply pour a few drops into your hands before applying it. Based on my experience so far, it feels comfortable on my skin and fits easily into my skincare routine. Overall, I’ve enjoyed using it and would continue reaching for it as a hydrating essence.
My skin LOVES this stuff. It helped with me darker areas from post acne hyperpigmentation and redness so much!

This is like my 3rd time purchasing this. I absolutely love it. It’s an immediately refreshing feeling once applied on my skin. It’s now a household favorite and is part of my daily skincare routine. It helps my skin bounce back and feel hydrated after my face washes and helps me feel more awake!
Works well on my skin as a toner. No allergic reaction like the other toners tried. Feels cool and refreshing after on my face.
Great toner, my skin instantly is soothed and nourished. My daughter is co using it with me it calms her acne following facial treatments.
Love this essence. Came in perfect condition. Will buy again.

this is my 2nd bottle ( i ordered the 1st from a different website that only delivered original items), the product is well sealed but was quite warm (it is summer but i still believe such items must be delivered in temperature control vehicles to maintain it in a good shape) i received 2 days before the estimated delivery date which was a plus. the product has a watery consistency, very mild (and pleasant earthly) scent, it maintains the skin barrier, prevents dryness, gives a beautifully subtle glow and with continuous use, heals redness and breakouts. perfect for layering. i use it as 1st essence and as many times per day as i feel like. highly recommend it. this is even better than the snail mucin essence by cosrx. especially if layered before numbuzn number 3 essence. perfect for summer and winter times. can be used on its own if your skin is not super dry.

avis.texte: I am a subscriber to this essence. I first got it at a shop. always been fan of Beauty of Joseon but never used this. I've used up 2 bottles now and currently subscribed to receive this every 4 months. This last a long time. Mybskin drinks it up absorbing very well. Lightweight, high quality with ginseng, softens my skin to prepare for serum and moistimureizer. Affordable and very good quality. This is an authentic product. Slightly sticky at first but dries down very quickly. For any skin type. I have combination skin that's dry, some parts oily and sensitive as well. and I am over 50yr old i use high end skincare and this. A+++ I hope my review was helpful to you. Have a beautiful day!

[Beauty of Joseon] Ginseng Essence Water. Nourishing essence that instantly hydrates, soothes and softens my dry, Sensitive and flaky prone skin. The essence has a thickened liquid feel. It absorbs and works quickly. Feels lightweight. Works well under my cream and makeup. Good first moisturizing layer. My makeup applies smoother and more evenly. Has a light ginseng scent that dissipates quickly. Per the description, the formula contains 80% Ginsengroot water and niacinamide 2% and is free of artificial fragrance, colorants, essential oil, and mineral oil. Made in Korea. Expiration date 20241107. Good for dry Sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Please let me know if the other product is new.
avis.texte: One star for the second product. I have two of the same product here, but if you look closely, there is a difference: the original one—which is almost finished—has Korean characters on the front above the word "Essence," whereas the other one doesn't. I ordered the second one four months ago because I loved the product so much and wanted to give it to a friend as a gift—I assume it might be a newer version or something—but her skin is peeling. I don't have photos, but I'm sharing my friend's feedback in the comments. I'm not sure what we should do.

I dont usually write product reviews but hopefully someone takes this into account when looking to purchase - this product contains NIACINAMIDE which can cause allergic reactions like it did for me. Obviously I wouldnt have purchased if i knew this was a possible side effect, but even just about 30 seconds after use my skin became inflamed and I started to feel a burning sensation. The more white parts you can see in the photos are my natural skin tone and this is 2 minutes after applying as directed. PLEASE DONT USE IF YOU HAVE A KNOWN HISTORY OF NIACIN REACTIONS !! Disappointed because I love trying new skin products but im not sure why a company would use an ingredient that has inflaming properties on a facial skincare product. Niacin flush is a well documented side affect for a large portion of the population, so please be aware of the affect this could have on your skin.
